meta.model: ArtaMatch quality — oriented toward happy, Lasso-selected, non-negative

rules.name: NOT(cycle_neptune_pluto_phase=Tau)
rules.human: Not both born under Neptune–Pluto in Taurus
rules.what: These are generational rhythms — they change over decades, not days, so this says the two of you belong to the same long season of history. It is the part of the reading that is about your era as much as about you. Here it is its ABSENCE that the model reads, which is the same doctrine stated the other way round.
rules.how: This condition does NOT hold. The slow cycle between Neptune and Pluto was passing through Taurus when both of you were born.

rules.name: comp_pluto_sign=Pis
rules.human: Pluto in Pisces, in the composite chart
rules.what: Pluto is depth, power and the things that transform a person. Pisces is mercy and dissolving.
rules.how: In the composite chart — the midpoint of the two birth charts, read as the chart of the relationship itself, Pluto sits in Pisces.

rules.name: cyclephase_neptune_pluto=DisseminatingxDisseminating
rules.human: Both born in the Disseminating phase of Neptune–Pluto
rules.what: Rudhyar read every planetary pair as a cycle with the same eight phases the Moon has — new, crescent, first quarter, gibbous, full, disseminating, last quarter, balsamic. The phase says where in a long story a birth falls: the new phase begins something, the full illuminates it, the balsamic lets it go.
rules.how: Measure the angle from Pluto to Neptune and read it as a lunation: his birth falls in the Disseminating phase, hers in the Disseminating.
